caption:
Which one did you need today? Tell us its number.

Eight promises for whatever this week is holding. Save this for the day you need it, and send it to someone carrying a lot.

Romans 8:31, 1 Peter 5:7, Exodus 14:14, Isaiah 60:22, Lamentations 3:23, Psalm 46:10, Philippians 4:13, Psalm 119:105 (BSB)

slides.text: If God is for us, who can be against us?
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.
I am the LORD; in its time I will accomplish it quickly.
They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
Be still and know that I am God
I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
Say Amen if you needed this today
